sloka: सुखम् हि कारणम् श्रुत्वा वैरस्य तव वानर ।आनन्तर्यद् विधास्यामि संप्रधार्य बलाबलम् ॥४-८-४२॥
transliteration: sukham hi kāraṇam śrutvā vairasya tava vānara ।ānantaryad vidhāsyāmi saṁpradhārya balābalam ॥4-8-42॥

translations.english: 'On hearing the cause of your enmity and considering your strength and weakness, I will take steps to make you happy.
